bullets.title: Leading a Culture of Safety and Psychological Safety
bullets.text: Safety culture reflects the values and behaviours that determine how an organisation responds to risk, error and improvement. Nurse leaders influence culture through their daily actions: whether they listen to concerns, respond fairly, support learning and model the standards expected of others.

bullets.title: Using Systems Thinking and Human Factors to Prevent Harm
bullets.text: Healthcare is a complex system in which people, equipment, technology, workload, environment and procedures interact. bullets.title: Digital Safety, Preparedness and Global Collaboration
bullets.text: Modern safety practice extends beyond the physical ward. Electronic records, clinical decision support, remote monitoring and connected devices can improve care but also introduce new risks.
